architecture_learning.finding: Section E+F items in Packs C+D use a staggered object structure in the JS array where items are split across array elements. A given array element may contain the content block of one item AND the metadata block of the next item. This differs from Section A items where each QID maps to a single object.
architecture_learning.impact: The formatItem function must NOT close the content block with '}' when replacing items mid-file. The closing brace belongs to a later item's metadata boundary.

Pre-validate ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] alignment before insertion — DL-008 errors can arise from lead-in word/content inconsistencies in choice text
Run DL-008 scan immediately after each batch insertion, not just at end
